added.summary: @font-face declares named font families: the cook bundles each url() source, and font-family (or the font shorthand) draws text in the first declared family, matched by font-style, font-weight range and unicode-range per CSS Fonts 4, falling back to the generic family's font role.

FontRole::Family(Family) names a document's @font-face family with a fallback role; Fonts::families holds its faces (FamilyFace, FaceStyle) and FontMetrics::with_range limits a face to its unicode-range.
